review.spedUp: You started well but sped up — by the end you were about {{totalMs}} ms ahead of the beat. Try counting out loud the whole way through.
review.slowedDown: You slowed down as you went — by the end you were about {{totalMs}} ms behind the beat. Keep the hand moving at a constant speed.
review.consistentlyEarly: You're playing about {{ms}} ms ahead of the beat throughout. Wait for the click rather than rushing to meet it.
review.consistentlyLate: You're landing about {{ms}} ms behind the beat throughout. Start the hand moving a little earlier.
review.uneven: Your strums are uneven — up to {{ms}} ms apart from each other. Drop to 70% speed until it settles.
review.noDynamics: Every strum came out at the same volume. The pattern asks for loud and soft — lean into the strokes drawn with a thick line.
review.accentsInverted: Your accents are landing on the wrong strums. Check which strokes are drawn thick in the pattern.
review.stopped: You played {{played}} of {{expected}} strums. Try again at a slower speed.
review.missedStrums: You missed {{count}} strums. Slow down, and keep the hand moving through the rests.
review.extraStrums: You added {{count}} strums that aren't in the pattern. On a rest the hand keeps moving without touching the strings.
review.greatTiming: {{percent}}% of your strums landed right on time. That's excellent.
review.greatDynamics: Your accents are exactly where they should be — that sounds musical.
review.steadyTempo: You held a steady tempo the whole way through.
review.playedEverything: You played every strum in the pattern without missing one.
review.keptGoing: You played {{count}} strums and didn't stop partway.
review.nothingHeard: We couldn't hear any playing. Check nothing is covering the microphone and try again.

calibration.title: Microphone calibration
calibration.explanation: There is a small delay between the moment your device makes a sound and the moment it hears one. Without measuring it, every strum looks later than it really was — and the app would blame you for the hardware's lag.
calibration.instructions: Put the phone on a table, keep the room quiet, and press start. The metronome will play eight beats and the microphone will record them.
calibration.failed: We couldn't measure it. Check the speaker isn't muted and try again somewhere quiet.

drill.title: Chord change drill
drill.explanation: Switch between two chords as many times as you can in a minute. We count the changes themselves, not the strums — so freezing on one chord won't score.
